subject.title: [Bug] Compaction-timeout recovery still leaves session assistant-last on 2026.6.11 (regression of #87472 / #88118) — and the continuation throw is scored as model candidate_failed

question: Should this issue own one combined fix for compaction-timeout assistant-tail recovery plus model-fallback misattribution, or should maintainers split the remaining work across the existing timeout, session-lock, and fallback-classification trackers?
rationale: The earlier snapshot trim already shipped, yet the reporter reproduced the failure on v2026.6.11; choosing the owner boundary affects whether the repair changes recovery persistence, fallback classification, timeout policy, or several paths together.

options.title: Keep this issue canonical
options.body: Use this issue to drive a combined recovery-state and fallback-classification fix, with related timeout and session-lock items linked as supporting context.

options.title: Split across existing trackers
options.body: Move the timeout-policy work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95553 and session-lock ownership work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95815, leaving this issue as regression evidence.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers can reproduce the exact large multimodal v2026.6.11 path with sanitized logs or a live run.

recommendation.title: Keep this issue canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue to drive a combined recovery-state and fallback-classification fix, with related timeout and session-lock items linked as supporting context.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the prior compaction-timeout snapshot fix and active retry preservation change, so he is the clearest routing owner for deciding whether those fixes need extension.
